name: 200mg | Blood Orange 1:1 CBC Sativa Enhanced Gummies
description:
Our Blood Orange CBC gummies are made with real fruit and a Sativa enhanced botanical terpene blend, making them a great addition to a day out and about. Whether eaten for a creative boost, or prepping for a dance party, these gummies are great for carefree adventures.

It's a little like a hot air balloon for your mood. Enjoy!

200mg THC:200mg CBC per container, 20mg THC:20mg CBC per serving.
